    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersShrimp cocktailChilled shrimp, iceberg, lemony horseradish sauce.Served lively. Keep your face clear of the bowl.How to make it500g peeled green prawns1 iceberg lettuce120g mayonnaise2 tbsp tomato sauce1 tsp horseradish1 lemon, squeezed1 tsp hot saucePoach the prawns in salted simmering water for 2 minutes until just cooked.Chill in iced water, then drain well.Mix the mayonnaise, tomato sauce, horseradish, lemon and hot sauce.Shred half the lettuce into four glasses, pile in the prawns and spoon the sauce over.Model town cheesesCheese houses, tomato and cornichon trees.Winter River, to scale. Found in the attic.How to make it120g cheddar120g gouda120g pepper jack250g cherry tomatoes100g cornichonsCut the cheddar, gouda and pepper jack into cubes.Stack the cubes into tiny houses on a long board.Thread the tomatoes and cornichons onto toothpicks as trees and stand them between the houses, like Adam's model town.MainsGrilled lobster tailsGarlic and parsley butter, shoestring fries, salad.The main event at the Deetzes'.How to make it4 lobster tails80g soft butter2 garlic cloves, crushed1 lemon, zested and juiced1 small bunch parsley, chopped800g potatoes1.5 L vegetable oil100g salad leavesSplit the lobster tails lengthways. Mash the butter with the garlic, lemon zest and parsley and brush over the flesh.Cut the potatoes into shoestrings, rinse and dry well.Fry the potatoes in the vegetable oil in batches at 180°C until crisp, drain and salt.Grill the lobster flesh side up until just opaque.Dress the salad leaves in lemon juice and serve with the lobster and fries.SweetsBlack and white cakeVanilla and chocolate sponge, white ganache.Stripes, naturally.How to make it200g butter200g caster sugar4 eggs250g self-raising flour80ml full cream milk2 tbsp cocoa powder150g white chocolate60ml thickened cream50g dark chocolateBeat the butter and sugar until pale, add the eggs one at a time and fold in the flour and milk.Stir the cocoa into half the batter.Pipe or spoon alternating stripes into a lined loaf tin.Bake at 170°C until a skewer comes out clean.Cool the cake in the tin (included in cook time).Melt the white chocolate with the cream and pour over the cake. Pipe stripes with the melted dark chocolate.DrinksBanana daiquiriBanana, lime, sugar syrup and ice. No rum.May cause sudden dancing. Resist.How to make it60g caster sugar60ml hot water180ml white rum3 limes, juiced to give 80ml2 ripe bananas1kg iceDissolve the sugar in the hot water.Cool the syrup for 10 minutes.Blend the rum, lime juice, syrup, bananas and ice until smooth and pour into chilled glasses.
